subject: general
question: To do a certain work, A is 40% more efficient than B. Working together, A and B can complete the same work in 15 days. A alone worked for 15 days. In how many days will B complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

A is 40% more efficient than B.

A and B together can complete the work in 15 days.

A alone worked for 15 days.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency ratio of A and B = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5.

Work = Efficiency × Time.

Total work = LCM of combined time taken by A and B.
